verdict.rationale: Docs confirm role types (owner/organizer/fileOrganizer/writer/commenter/reader) and folder-to-file inheritance ('Access you apply to a folder is inherited by all files within it'), plus permissions resources for files, folders, and shared drives. However, there's no dedicated IT-admin-focused documentation on inheritance edge cases (e.g., overrides, conflicting permissions, shared drive vs My Drive inheritance differences) or admin console-specific controls. missing for 10: admin console granular policy documentation, detailed inheritance override/conflict rules, independent/hands-on validation of inheritance behavior at scale.
